name: nova-lang
description: Sharif NOVA - a unified, natural-reading programming language developed by Sharif Technologies. Core language, lists/records, typed procedures, DATA named types, persistence, a stdlib, ASK input, TRY/CATCH, a PAGE compiler (static/data-bound/interactive HTML), and SERVICE/API (a live HTTP server, now serving PAGE routes too, with per-record BUTTON + CALL API).
author: Sharif_tech
